Guides › CI, hooks and Docker

CI, hooks and Docker

Pare has no server and no config file, so each of these is a few lines. All of them run pare --check-only, which reports syntax Pare cannot erase and writes nothing. Exit code 1 means a rejection, 2 means an I/O or usage error; see The pare command.

GitHub Actions

YAML 
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
    with:
      dotnet-version: 10.0.x
  - run: dotnet tool install -g Extrode.Pare.Cli
  - run: pare src --check-only

The .NET tool needs the .NET 10 runtime, which setup-dotnet installs. To skip .NET, download the archive for linux-x64 from the releases page and put pare on the PATH. For type errors, add a tsc --noEmit step; see Type checking in CI.

For a project that uses the MSBuild package, dotnet build already fails on a rejection, so no extra step is needed.

A git pre-commit hook

Save as .git/hooks/pre-commit and make it executable (chmod +x). It checks only the staged .ts and .mts files, so a commit that touches none of them costs nothing.

bash 
#!/bin/sh
files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.ts' '*.mts' ':!*.d.ts')
[ -z "$files" ] && exit 0
pare --check-only $files

A staged enum stops the commit with bad.ts:1:1: error PARE100: .... File names with spaces need a while read loop instead of the unquoted $files.

Hook frameworks work the same way. For pre-commit, a local hook:

YAML 
repos:
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: pare
        name: pare --check-only
        entry: pare --check-only
        language: system
        files: '\.m?ts$'
        exclude: '\.d\.ts$'

Docker

Strip in a build stage and copy only the output. The tool image needs the .NET 10 SDK:

dockerfile 
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS strip
RUN dotnet tool install -g Extrode.Pare.Cli
ENV PATH="$PATH:/root/.dotnet/tools"
COPY src /src
RUN pare /src --outdir /out

FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=strip /out /usr/share/nginx/html

--outdir mirrors the input folder under /out (src/lib/a.ts becomes /out/lib/a.js).
